blocks.text: The module documentation defines the JSON shape, permissions, atomic write behavior, fingerprint binding, caps, reasons, and fail-closed project decision.
blocks.title: Protected trust-store contract

blocks.text: TrustEntry and TrustState carry stored and evaluated decisions. canonical_root resolves real absolute paths, while _valid_fingerprint and _entry reject malformed values.
blocks.title: Trust records and validation

blocks.text: TrustStore selects the default config path and reads the file using ownership, mode, regular-file, race, size, UTF-8, JSON version, and entry-shape checks.
blocks.title: Safe store reads

blocks.text: set validates and replaces a root decision, drops oldest entries over the cap, and writes atomically. forget removes one decision, while _sync_dir makes the rename durable when possible.
blocks.title: Decision persistence

blocks.text: project_trust_state computes a fingerprint once, returns fixed reasons for problems or empty projects, compares stored entries, and never raises. Only matching trusted fingerprints produce trusted state.
blocks.title: Project trust evaluation

blocks.text: _state derives trusted and needs_prompt flags from the reason, stores files and fingerprint metadata, and logs only the reason and file count.
blocks.title: State construction

gotchas: Malformed entries are ignored while malformed files invalidate the store.
A trusted decision never overrides a current fingerprint problem.
The store is read anew for each operation.

purpose: TrustStore reads and writes a bounded, permission-checked JSON file keyed by canonical project roots and fingerprints. project_trust_state computes the current fingerprint, compares it with a stored trusted or declined decision, and fails closed for unsafe, changed, damaged, or unreadable inputs.
summary: Stores protected project trust decisions and evaluates whether a folder may be trusted.
